From restaurant owners to healthcare managers and retail supervisors, leaders across various industries ask how to manage their staff more efficiently, save time, and protect their margins. Here’s how When I Work turns operational chaos into a smooth, predictable workday.
What is employee scheduling software and how does it work?
Employee scheduling software is a digital tool that helps managers create, share, and adjust work schedules in less time. With When I Work, you can assign shifts, approve time off, and track attendance from one place instead of juggling spreadsheets or group texts.
The system automatically updates everyone’s schedule in real time, so employees always know when and where they’re working, reducing confusion, missed shifts, and last-minute chaos.
How does workforce scheduling help reduce labor costs?
Workforce scheduling tools, such as When I Work, provide managers with real-time visibility into staffing levels and labor budgets. You can forecast busy periods, prevent overtime , and fill open shifts faster, all from your phone or desktop.
For industries with fluctuating demand, such as restaurants , healthcare , and retail , these insights mean you’re never under- or over-staffed. Over time, smarter scheduling leads to lower labor costs, better coverage, and happier employees.
Can I use When I Work for time and attendance tracking, too?
Yes. When I Work includes built-in time and attendance software, so you don’t need to manage multiple systems. Employees can clock in or out directly from their phones, using GPS and geofencing technology to prevent time theft and prevent unauthorized clock-ins when needed, or just turn any device into a secure time clock.
Managers can review timesheets, approve breaks, and export accurate payroll data in seconds, or integrate directly with top payroll providers. It’s a complete attendance solution designed to save time and improve accuracy across every shift.
Is When I Work suitable for teams across multiple locations or job sites?
Absolutely. When I Work is built for deskless and shift-based teams who need to stay connected across different job sites, stores, or departments. Managers can view who’s clocked in, fill shifts, and message employees instantly, all from one dashboard.
Employees can clock in from any approved location, check schedules, and request time off right from the app. It’s ideal for teams that move between sites or manage multiple locations and need real-time visibility without extra admin.
What industries benefit most from workforce scheduling software?
When I Work is trusted across dozens of industries where shift work is essential, including restaurants, retail, healthcare, construction , education , and hospitality brands, such as hotels and resorts . Managers in these fields use workforce scheduling software to organize complex schedules, minimize absenteeism, and provide employees with greater control over their shifts. Whether you’re running a coffee shop, clinic, or call center , When I Work helps you manage people and time with less stress.

When I Work offers simple, transparent pricing that fits businesses of all sizes. Plans start at just $2.50 per user per month, and unlike most competitors, features like time tracking, team messaging, and integrations are all included. Pricing is flexible and scales with your team size. You pay in affordable user tiers, so you only pay for what your business actually needs. No long-term contracts or hidden fees.
You can also adjust your plan at any time or use hibernation options during seasonal downtime, making it perfect for businesses that scale up or down throughout the year. Pricing is billed in user tiers of five, keeping costs predictable and fair for every team.
